demoQuestions: Which grids have the highest anomaly scores?
Check whether their data pipeline completed successfully.
notes: Start the existing FastAPI backend first: uvicorn mainapi:app --reload from the fastapi folder.
The MCP server wraps API1-API6 and does not directly query MySQL, Parquet or GeoJSON.
Validation limits grid_id to 1-10000 and limits result sizes.
NOC_API_BASE_URL is restricted to local http://127.0.0.1 or localhost.
